mcpGuide.title: Integration Standards and Layers
mcpGuide.subtitle: What an internal business system must follow when implementing an MCP server.

criteria.title: One-line decision rule
criteria.processCond: A long-running flow involving multiple departments and roles, including human intervention
criteria.n8nCond: Flow control over simple tasks; mechanical work
criteria.n8nResult: → n8n workflow (registered as the agent of a single process task)
criteria.toolCond: A capability that completes in a single call
criteria.notePrefix: The dividing line is not complexity but
criteria.noteSuffix: . An n8n workflow may have dozens of nodes, yet it is still mechanical control flow; the moment departments, roles, approvals, and waiting appear, the layer changes.

layers.processDesc: A long-running business flow involving people and agents. It owns approvals, roles, state, SLAs, and auditing.
layers.automationDesc: Deterministic system-to-system connection and transformation that completes inside a single task. n8n workflows belong here and are registered as an agent type.
layers.capabilityDesc: A stateless, single-call tool — a Tool on an MCP server.
layers.containment: MCP Tool ⊂ n8n workflow ⊂ Process GPT process

position.n8n: A means of executing a task (agent type)
position.process: The top level of business orchestration

lifetime.n8n: Seconds to minutes, a single execution context
lifetime.process: Days to months, with suspend, resume, and wait

human.process: A first-class concept — work items, forms, approvals, rejections

state.process: Instance variables and a state machine

branching.process: Gateways + DMN decision tables + decision history

change.process: Process definition versions and version tags

examples.process: Partner onboarding, leave approval, proposal review

check.intro: Verify that your MCP server follows the standards before registering it.
